title: Cloud Offload Skill for Skills Pipeline
summary: The user wants to offload heavy skill executions (to-seed, to-tasks) to remote cloud VMs to preserve local context window and save local compute, while keeping artifact files local and out of the corporate GitHub repo. The solution requires a new cloud-offload skill that wraps the isolation: "remote" Agent tool pattern, passes input content to the cloud VM, runs the target skill there, reads the output file, and returns content as text to the local orchestrator which writes files locally. The user's dotfiles repo (public on GitHub) is already configured as a cloud environment setup script that clones dotfiles on VM boot, making skills available at ~/.cch/skills/ on cloud VMs.
problem_statement: Running /to-seed and /to-tasks locally consumes significant local context window and blocks the local session during long-running skill executions.
solution: A new cloud-offload skill that accepts a target skill name and input content, spawns a remote agent with isolation: "remote" and the correct model tier, runs the target skill on the cloud VM, reads the output file content, and returns it to the local orchestrator which writes files locally. Files never touch GitHub.
decisions: Cloud environment setup script clones https://github.com/Eric-Lingren/dotfiles.git to ~/.dotfiles on VM boot, creating symlinks so skills are available at ~/.cch/skills/
Dotfiles repo is public; no auth token needed in setup script
Cloud setup script tested and verified: 28 skills available at ~/.cch/skills/ on cloud VM
cch --cloud "description" / cco --cloud "description" creates cloud sessions from terminal
--teleport attaches session to local terminal (local execution), not cloud VM
True cloud VM execution requires browser interaction or isolation: "remote" subagent pattern
File content transfers between cloud VM and local via text in agent responses; local session writes files to disk
Local context window is preserved because remote agent intermediate work stays on VM context, only final text result returns
The delegate array in model-tiers.json is for local Haiku delegation only; it does not handle remote cloud execution
isolation: "remote" is not present anywhere in the current skills/scripts codebase; this is net-new infrastructure
A new skill (cloud-offload or similar) is needed; extending the delegate pattern is off the table
Artifact files (seed JSON, task JSON) must not be committed to corporate GitHub repo; they stay local only
Skills write output files to cloud VM disk; the remote agent wrapper must read and return full file content as text
Cold VM startup overhead is approximately 30-60 seconds per remote agent spawn
Model tiers already properly assigned in model-tiers.json and synced to SKILL.md frontmatter
to-seed is T3 (sonnet/high), to-tasks is T3 (sonnet/high), debug is T4 (opus/xhigh), grill-me is T4 (opus/xhigh)

implementation_decisions: New skill accepts: target skill name + input content as arguments
Skill looks up model tier from model-tiers.json for the target skill
Skill spawns Agent with isolation: "remote" and the correct model param
Remote agent prompt instructs: run the target skill, then cat the output file and return full content
Local orchestrator writes the returned content to a local path (not in the corporate repo)
Default output paths: /Users/eric/.dotfiles/docs/seeds/ for seeds, /Users/eric/.dotfiles/docs/tasks/ for tasks

risks_and_tradeoffs: Cold VM startup adds 30-60s per remote spawn; only worthwhile for long-running skills
Remote agent must be explicitly instructed to read and return output file content; standard skill invocation alone is insufficient
Effort level control on remote agents is unverified; may not behave identically to local /effort
